title: Automotive mmWave Spinning Radar Place Recognition with Spatially Gated Feature-Correlation Representation
abstract: arXiv:2609.27394v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automotive spinning FMCW radar provides dense, $360^\circ$ sensing and remains reliable under poor illumination and adverse weather, making it well-suited to autonomous navigation. Place recognition uses these observations to identify previously visited locations for re-localization and long-term navigation. However, heading changes appear as circular shifts in the polar radar representation, and conventional global aggregation can lose relationships among radar responses that are important for distinguishing similar places. We propose SGCA-Net, a spinning radar place recognition framework that combines rotation-robust feature extraction with Spatially Gated Correlation Aggregation (SGCA). SGCA learns spatial weights to reduce the influence of unstable and ambiguous radar regions, while aggregating pairwise correlations among local responses to preserve informative feature relationships. tldr: 提出SGCA-Net框架，通过空间门控相关聚合（SGCA）学习空间权重以抑制不稳定模糊的雷达区域影响，并聚合局部响应间的成对相关性，从而实现旋转鲁棒的车载毫米波旋转雷达位置识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SGCA-Net, which combines rotation-robust feature extraction with Spatially Gated Correlation Aggregation (SGCA) that learns spatial weights to suppress unstable radar regions while aggregating pairwise correlations among local responses, achieving robust place recognition for automotive spinning mmWave radar.
